installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

# -- Colors & Formatting --
BOLD='\033[1m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
CYAN='\033[0;36m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m'

# -- Banner --
echo -e "${BLUE}##################################################${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}#                                                #${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}#      ${BOLD}${YELLOW}MINECRAFT BEDROCK INSTALLER${NC}${BLUE}              #${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}#           ${CYAN}Powered By YuraCloud${NC}${BLUE}                #${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}#                                                #${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}##################################################${NC}"
echo ""

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Updating package lists..."
apt-get update -y -qq

echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Installing dependencies..."
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl wget unzip
echo -e "${GREEN}[DONE]${NC} Dependencies installed."

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# -------------------------------------------------------
# If zip already pre-uploaded, skip download entirely
# -------------------------------------------------------
if [ -f "bedrock-server.zip" ]; then
    echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Found pre-uploaded bedrock-server.zip, skipping download."
    DOWNLOAD_OK=true
else

    # Resolve version
    if [ -z "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" ] || [ "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
        echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Fetching latest Bedrock version..."
        SCRAPED_URL=$(curl -sSL --max-time 30 \
            -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' \
            -H 'Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.5' \
            'https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/download/server/bedrock' 2>/dev/null \
            | grep -Eo 'https://[a-zA-Z0-9.\/_-]*bin-linux/bedrock-server-[0-9.]+\.zip' \
            | head -1 || true)
        if [ -n "${SCRAPED_URL}" ]; then
            BEDROCK_VERSION=$(echo "${SCRAPED_URL}" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+')
            echo -e "${GREEN}[DONE]${NC} Detected latest version: ${BOLD}${BEDROCK_VERSION}${NC}"
        else
            echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} Page scrape failed. Using fallback version 1.21.90.4"
            BEDROCK_VERSION="1.21.90.4"
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Using specified version: ${BOLD}${BEDROCK_VERSION}${NC}"
    fi

    echo ""
    echo -e "${CYAN}--------------------------------------------------${NC}"
    echo -e " Target Version : ${BOLD}${BEDROCK_VERSION}${NC}"
    echo -e " Source         : minecraft.net (Official CDN)"
    echo -e "${CYAN}--------------------------------------------------${NC}"
    echo ""

    DOWNLOAD_URLS=(
        "https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/bedrock-server-${BEDROCK_VERSION}.zip"
        "https://minecraft.azureedge.net/bin-linux/bedrock-server-${BEDROCK_VERSION}.zip"
    )

    DOWNLOAD_OK=false
    for url in "${DOWNLOAD_URLS[@]}"; do
        echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Trying: ${url}"
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Download attempt ${attempt}/3..."
            if wget --tries=1 --timeout=120 --progress=dot:mega -O bedrock-server.zip "${url}" 2>&1; then
                if unzip -t bedrock-server.zip > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                    FILESIZE=$(du -h bedrock-server.zip | cut -f1)
                    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} Download complete! File size: ${BOLD}${FILESIZE}${NC}"
                    DOWNLOAD_OK=true
                    break 2
                else
                    echo -e "${RED}[FAIL]${NC} Not a valid zip. Skipping."
                    rm -f bedrock-server.zip
                    break
                fi
            else
                echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} Failed. Retrying in 5s..."
                rm -f bedrock-server.zip
                sleep 5
            fi
        done
    done

    if [ "${DOWNLOAD_OK}" != "true" ]; then
        echo ""
        echo -e "${RED}[FAIL]${NC} Could not download bedrock-server-${BEDROCK_VERSION}.zip"
        echo -e "${RED}       The install container cannot reach the internet.${NC}"
        echo ""
        echo -e "${YELLOW}  Fix 1${NC} - Fix Docker DNS on your Pterodactyl node:"
        echo "    echo '{\"dns\":[\"1.1.1.1\",\"8.8.8.8\"]}' > /etc/docker/daemon.json"
        echo "    systemctl restart docker"
        echo ""
        echo -e "${YELLOW}  Fix 2${NC} - Upload zip manually via SFTP/File Manager:"
        echo "    1. Download bedrock-server-${BEDROCK_VERSION}.zip from minecraft.net"
        echo "    2. Upload to server root, rename to 'bedrock-server.zip'"
        echo "    3. Click Reinstall"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Back up existing config files
echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Backing up config files..."
for f in server.properties permissions.json allowlist.json whitelist.json; do
    if [ -f "${f}" ]; then
        cp -f "${f}" "${f}.bak"
        echo -e "         Backed up ${f}"
    fi
done

# Extract
echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Unpacking server files..."
FILE_COUNT=$(unzip -l bedrock-server.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')
echo -e "         Extracting ${BOLD}${FILE_COUNT}${NC} files..."
unzip -q -o bedrock-server.zip
rm -f bedrock-server.zip
echo -e "${GREEN}[DONE]${NC} Extraction complete."

# Restore config files
echo -e "${CYAN}[INFO]${NC} Restoring config files..."
for f in server.properties permissions.json allowlist.json whitelist.json; do
    if [ -f "${f}.bak" ]; then
        cp -f "${f}.bak" "${f}"
        echo -e "         Restored ${f}"
    fi
done

# Verify binary
if [ ! -f bedrock_server ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}[FAIL]${NC} bedrock_server binary not found after extraction!"
    ls -la /mnt/server/
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x bedrock_server

# Write startup wrapper with banner
cat > start.sh << 'STARTSCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
echo ""
echo "=================================================="
printf "%-50s\n" "${SERVER_LABEL:-YuraCloud}"
echo "=================================================="
echo "Informasi Server:"
echo "UUID      : ${P_SERVER_UUID}"
echo "Region    : ${REGION:-Singapore}"
echo "Port      : ${P_SERVER_PORT}"
echo "Egg Type  : Vanilla Bedrock"
echo "Version   : ${BEDROCK_VERSION:-latest}"
echo "=================================================="
printf "Terima kasih sudah membeli di %s!\n" "${SERVER_LABEL:-YuraCloud}"
echo "=================================================="
echo ""
exec ./bedrock_server
STARTSCRIPT
chmod +x start.sh

echo ""
echo -e "${BLUE}##################################################${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}        Installation Completed Successfully!${NC}"
echo -e " Version  : ${BOLD}${BEDROCK_VERSION}${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}##################################################${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}          Thank you for using YuraCloud.${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}##################################################${NC}"
echo ""
